user.title: New resource queue
user.description: Name the queue and choose the entities it will supervise. Capacity, ordering and repeated requests are configured in the next steps.

data_description.name: A name to distinguish this queue from other queues (for example Heating).
data_description.max_active: Classic: 1–50 simultaneous slots. Weighted: 1–100000 shared units (not watts).
data_description.strategy: FIFO grants by arrival order; LIFO grants the newest waiting request; Priority FIFO ranks waiting requests first. Active reservations are never interrupted.
data_description.monitored_entities: Optional during setup. Devices must belong to only one resource queue.
data_description.capacity_mode: Classic counts active slots; Weighted counts integer units independently of FIFO/LIFO/Priority FIFO.
data_description.recurrence_mode: Ignore (default): keep v1.0 idempotence. Count: increase occurrences only for a repeated pending resource_id; never duplicate an entry or change its order, weight or priority.
data_description.allocation_mode: Strict (default): stop when the first waiting request does not fit. Backfill: skip blocked requests and grant later ones that fit, preserving their relative order. A large or high-priority request may starve.

strategy.title: Strategy configuration
strategy.description: Configure settings provided by the selected scheduling strategy.

data_description.priority_order: Highest first: 10 before 1. Lowest first: 1 before 10. Equal priorities retain arrival order.

weights.title: Default weights per entity
weights.description: Enter one positive integer unit cost per supervised entity. These defaults apply only to new requests; engine_data.weight may override a single request. Each form field is the entity ID.

request.name: Request slot
request.description: Request a resource queue slot without actuating an entity.

resource_id.name: Resource ID
resource_id.description: Stable resource identifier, for example zone_1.

entity_id.name: Supervised entity
entity_id.description: Associated Home Assistant entity. Lights, switches, fans and input_booleans must be OFF before release; other entities only require a verified available state.

config_entry_id.name: Resource queue
config_entry_id.description: Target a particular queue. Optional only when exactly one queue is installed.

strategy_data.name: Strategy request data
strategy_data.description: Required for Priority FIFO: strategy_data.priority (a number from 1 to 10). FIFO and LIFO require no extra fields.

engine_data.name: Capacity request data
engine_data.description: Weighted mode only: engine_data.weight overrides the entity's default unit cost for this request. Must be a positive integer not exceeding total capacity.

release.name: Release slot
release.description: Release an ON/OFF reservation only after OFF is confirmed; logical resources require a verified available state.

config_entry_id.name: Resource queue
config_entry_id.description: Target a particular queue. Optional only when exactly one queue is installed.

cancel.name: Cancel request
cancel.description: Withdraw a waiting request or release an active reservation according to its entity supervision mode.

config_entry_id.name: Resource queue
config_entry_id.description: Target a particular queue. Optional only when exactly one queue is installed.

resume.name: Resume queue after restart
resume.description: Verify supervised entities and resume grants. Inspect equipment before recovery.

config_entry_id.name: Resource queue
config_entry_id.description: Target a particular queue. Optional only when exactly one queue is installed.

init.description: Choose what you want to change. The other settings will be preserved. Opening a category does not pause the queue.
